create_base_dataset: create a BaseDataset subclass that reads metadata and prepares training data with image coordinates and RGB values
prepare_train_data: prepare training data by collecting all image coordinates and RGB values into concatenated tensors
shuffle_dataset: shuffle the dataset coordinates and RGB tensors randomly for training with optional patch-based shuffling
crop_batch_tensors: crop a batch of tensors to a center region using specified width and height deltas
patchify_tensor: patchify a tensor into fixed-width patches with random offset and boundary removal for patch-based training
